name: Kogan.com Ltd
summary: Kogan.com Ltd operates as an online retailer in Australia and New Zealand. The company offers various brands across a range of categories, including consumer electronics, appliances, homewares, hardware, toys, and others, as well as furniture, gaming, and other entertainment products; and owns and operates private label brands. It also provides pre-paid mobile phone plans. In addition, the company offers general insurances, including home, contents, and car, as well as pet and life insurance; and NBN internet plans.
